verdicts.typography: Flawless Swiss-style hierarchy. The mono uppercase micro-labels (e.g., 'GLOBAL LANDSCAPE', 'THE FIELD', stat strip labels) are perfectly disciplined. Heading scale is bold and rhythmic, body text has generous line-height, and the red accent on 'this?' in the hero creates exact intended emphasis without breaking the near-black/white discipline.
verdicts.color: Excellent minimalist palette with one visible nitpick: in the Verdict section (d6), the phrase 'it is the integration' is rendered in the accent red, but the preceding em-dash and the trailing period are black. This breaks the visual weight of the red callout and looks like a partial application of the accent color to inline text rather than a clean block-level highlight. All other color usage—the sticky-column shadow exception, the 'THIS SYSTEM' column rule, the red bullets, and the nav active state—is perfectly restrained and consistent.
verdicts.layout: Publication-grade grid alignment. The max-w container is consistent across all sections. Whitespace rhythm is generous and Swiss-correct. Hairline borders on the matrix table, analysis cards, and accordion rows are crisp with no double-border or misalignment defects. The footer is correctly pinned at the document bottom with proper top margin separation from content.
verdicts.components: High-quality component execution with one concrete defect: in the scrolled matrix state (d9), the sticky first column ('CAPABILITY') correctly pins and casts its functional shadow as specified, but the column header text 'CAPABILITY' appears slightly misaligned or clipped at its left edge compared to the unscrolled state (d3). The accordion affordances, stat strip, sticky nav, and final-column 2px red rule are all flawlessly implemented.
verdicts.responsive: Mobile layout is robust with correct text wrapping, readable typography, and a well-implemented horizontal scroll for the matrix table. Dark mode contrast is excellent and the palette is consistent across all sections. One minor visual inconsistency was identified in the desktop dark mode matrix table.

color: In the Verdict section (d6), ensure that when applying the red accent to the phrase 'it is the integration', the surrounding punctuation (em-dash and period) either shares the red color or the entire sentence fragment is wrapped in a span with the accent color to avoid a fragmented visual weight.
components: Inspect the CSS for the sticky first column header ('CAPABILITY') in the matrix table; verify that left padding or text-indent is not being overridden when position:sticky is engaged during horizontal scroll, as the header text appears to shift or clip slightly leftward in the scrolled state (d9) versus the initial state (d3).
responsive: In 'k2-dark-matrix', the sticky first column ('CAPABILITY' / 'THIS SYSTEM') uses a lighter background shade (#1a1a1a) compared to the standard data rows (#111111). While this aids legibility, it creates a slight tonal break in the monolithic Swiss grid aesthetic; consider unifying the row background or ensuring the z-index layering of the sticky column perfectly matches the container depth.
